PINTAR — read-only identity check, requested by Second Eye before §3b.

Editing this file runs verify-identity.yml. It lists Auth users with the
service-role key (GET only) and reports how many match the digest of the
identity §3b would bind, and the day each was created. It prints no email,
no user id and no metadata. It writes, creates and consumes nothing.
§3b and §3c are not part of this and remain held for Yazid.
